tokens.name: coral-50
tokens.usage: Palette step. Source of bg-brand-soft (light): selected chips, upload drop area, icon circles.

tokens.name: coral-100
tokens.usage: Palette step. Tint block on the cover; hover on brand-soft surfaces.

tokens.name: coral-200
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark theme pressed primary and text on bg-brand-soft (dark).

tokens.name: coral-300
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark theme primary fill, links and focus ring.

tokens.name: coral-400
tokens.usage: THE brand coral (Purrello Coral). Splash, login hero, onboarding and empty-state backgrounds, the logo. Never behind body text: white on it is 2.3:1, so only the wordmark (logotype, exempt) sits on it.

tokens.name: coral-500
tokens.usage: Palette step. Illustration shading, chart series for the brand.

tokens.name: coral-600
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light theme primary button fill (white text 4.6:1).

tokens.name: coral-700
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light theme pressed primary, links, focus ring (5.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: coral-800
tokens.usage: Palette step. Text and icons on bg-brand-soft in light theme (7.4:1).

tokens.name: coral-dusk
tokens.usage: Dark-theme brand coral: the login/splash hero in dark mode. Coral-400 dimmed one step so a large field does not glare at night. White wordmark on it is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: slate-0
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light surface.

tokens.name: slate-25
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light page background (the login screen's off-white).

tokens.name: slate-50
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light sunken / disabled fill.

tokens.name: slate-100
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light hairline divider.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light disabled text.

tokens.name: slate-400
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light control border (3.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: slate-500
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light secondary text.

tokens.name: slate-800
tokens.usage: Palette step. Light primary ink (the login screen's 'Welcome' colour).

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark page background — warm near-black so it sits with coral instead of fighting it.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark surface (cards, inputs, sheets).

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark sunken / disabled fill.

tokens.name: night-600
tokens.usage: Palette step. Dark hairline divider.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Screen background. Light #F7F9FB (slate-25), dark #171213 (night-900).

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, secondary buttons, menus, sheets. Light #FFFFFF, dark #211B1B.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, skeletons, progress track, file-type tiles. Light #EEF2F6, dark #2B2423.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: Brand hero (splash, login, onboarding, empty states). Light #F08F8A (coral-400), dark #A85550 (coral-dusk). Only the wordmark and paw pattern sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chip, tonal button, active tab pill, icon circles, active drop zone. Light #FEF1F0; dark #8E4541 — coral-dusk one step deeper, so selection reads as coral, never brown.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body, input values on bg-page and bg-surface (10.8:1 light / 16.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, helper text, placeholders, icons on bg-page, bg-surface, bg-subtle (≥4.5:1 light, ≥6.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for readable info.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links, ghost buttons, active icons on bg-surface / bg-page (5.6:1 / 8.1:1).

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: The PURRELLO wordmark on bg-brand (2.3:1 light — logotype only; 5.2:1 dark). Not for body text.

tokens.name: text-on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Text/icons on bg-brand-soft: selected chips, tonal buttons, active tab icon (7.4:1 light / 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: paw-print
tokens.usage: Paw pattern on bg-brand: a lighter tone of the same coral (tone-on-tone), light #F5ABA7 on coral-400, dark #B86A65 on coral-dusk. Never over content.

tokens.name: bg-hero
tokens.usage: Warm tab-root header (AppHeader), passport card, lost-alert photo area. Light #FCDFDC; dark = the same coral-dusk as the splash/login hero, so the brand colour carries into the app instead of a brown tint.

tokens.name: hero-paw
tokens.usage: Decorative paw prints inside bg-hero headers and the passport card. Decoration only.

tokens.name: hero-text-1
tokens.usage: Title and icons on bg-hero (9.0:1 light / 5.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: hero-text-2
tokens.usage: Second line on bg-hero: light #7B3F3A (6.4:1); dark white at regular weight (5.2:1) — hierarchy comes from size and weight, not opacity.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Coach mark (one-time tip) bubble.

tokens.name: text-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on bg-inverse (11.3:1 / 16.1:1).

tokens.name: link-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Action link on bg-inverse, e.g. “Anladım” (7.1:1 / 7.0:1).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected radio/checkbox, progress fill, selected chip border.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed / hover.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on action-primary (4.6:1 / 8.6:1).

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outlines, menu outline. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, dropdown, chip and secondary button borders (≥3:1 on bg-surface and bg-page in both themes).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element; focused input border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done vaccinations, completed uploads, healthy status. Text and icons on bg-surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge / banner background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Upcoming vaccination, expiring passport certificate, near-full storage.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge / banner background.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Overdue vaccination, field errors, failed upload, destructive actions. Always with an icon or word; it sits close to the coral hue.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge, destructive (tonal) button, error banner background.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Logotype on bg-brand only. Uppercase, Light 300, tracking 0.3em. 28px on small splash sizes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen, onboarding/login greeting and big empty states.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headers inside a screen, bottom sheet titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, list item primary line, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Default reading text, input values (16px stops iOS zoom).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dense lists, card descriptions, menu items.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in list items, metadata.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons lg/md. Sentence case, never uppercase. Small buttons use 14px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels, chip text, tabs, small buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: PDF, JPG, PNG · en fazla 25 MB
styles.usage: Helper/error text, timestamps, file meta. Minimum size for readable text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Bottom tab bar labels and badge counts only.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Expense totals, weight, key stats on dashboard cards. Turkish formatting: 12.400,50 ₺.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight spots, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, icon-to-label in buttons, label-to-field gap (6–8).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner gap in inputs (icon ↔ text), list item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, input horizontal padding, stack gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Chip row side inset when scrolled.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, primary button horizontal padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top of content under a hero / wave.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: File-type tiles, menu items, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, dropdown triggers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, upload area, file rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pill), chips, avatars, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards (optional; prefer border-subtle).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

size.note: Heights and touch targets. px = iOS pt = Android dp.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary/secondary buttons, text fields, dropdown triggers.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Medium buttons, menu items; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and chips (hit area padded to 44).

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside inputs, chips and buttons.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled images/illustrations (text uses text-disabled instead).
